comment: Package kit hints for QR codes (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). QR is open to everyone signed in: each person sees their own codes (lists come back filtered, compared with the superadmin's), templates are shared. No other module links to QR; the probes below cover its public side (the redirect of a dynamic code), which printed codes depend on.

apiParams.id: SELECT id FROM qr_codes ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.slug: SELECT slug FROM qr_codes WHERE dynamic AND slug IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.file: SELECT design->'logo'->>'file' FROM qr_codes WHERE design->'logo'->>'file' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

pageParams.id: SELECT id FROM qr_codes ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

openToUsersWhy: bootstrap: the shared templates, the module settings and the person's own counters (codes inside are the person's own)

pageParamsWhy: `:id` is a code id for /app/qr/:id and a template id for /app/qr/templates/:id (one name in both routes): the first code and the template with the same number (the ready-made templates are ids 1…8)
